Special Buyer Programme

A signature highlight of TextileExpo Uzbekistan, the Special Buyer Programme is a powerful business platform that every year draws a growing number of manufacturers, wholesale buyers, retailers, and suppliers from across Central Asia and far beyond.

TextileExpo Uzbekistan 2026 brought together more than 700 key buyers.

Top 5 visiting countries:
Russia – 25%
Kazakhstan – 17%
China – 16%
Kyrgyz Republic – 15%
Tajikistan – 10%
